name: Dulwich Park Playground
description: A large children's playground for children up to 14, plus a second playground, in Green Flag-winning Dulwich Park. There are toilets by the main car park, in the Francis Peek building and behind the café; the Dulwich Clock café opens 8am to 5.30pm (6pm on Saturdays). The park also has a boating lake with pedalos and rowing boats and a cycle hire outlet. Gates open at 7.30am.
